verses.original: Ὅθεν ἀδελφοὶ ἅγιοι κλήσεως ἐπουρανίου μέτοχοι κατανοήσατε τὸν Ἀπόστολον καὶ Ἀρχιερέα τῆς ὁμολογίας ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: Hothen adelphoi hagioi klēseōs epouraniou metochoi katanoēsate ton Apostolon kai Archierea tēs homologias hēmōn Iēsoun
verses.literal: Therefore holy brothers who share in the heavenly calling set your focus on Jesus the apostle and high priest whom we confess
verses.literalPt: Por isso, santos irmãos, participantes de uma vocação celestial, considerai atentamente o Apóstolo e o Sumo Sacerdote da nossa confissão, Jesus,

verses.original: πιστὸν ὄντα τῷ ποιήσαντι αὐτὸν ὡς καὶ Μωϋσῆς ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: piston onta tō poiēsanti auton hōs kai Mōusēs en holō tō oikō autou
verses.literal: He was faithful to the One who appointed Him just as Moses was faithful in all God’s house
verses.literalPt: o qual era fiel ao que o constituiu, como também Moisés o era em toda a casa de Deus.

verses.original: Πλείονος γὰρ οὗτος δόξης παρὰ Μωϋσῆν ἠξίωται καθ’ ὅσον πλείονα τιμὴν ἔχει τοῦ οἴκου ὁ κατασκευάσας αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Pleionos gar houtos doxēs para Mōusēn ēxiōtai kath’ hoson pleiona timēn echei tou oikou ho kataskeuasas auton
verses.literal: For Jesus has been counted worthy of greater glory than Moses just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself
verses.literalPt: Pois ele é tido por digno de tanta maior glória que Moisés, quanto aquele que estabeleceu a casa tem maior honra que a mesma casa.

verses.original: πᾶς γὰρ οἶκος κατασκευάζεται ὑπό τινος ὁ δὲ πάντα κατασκευάσας Θεός
verses.transliteration: pas gar oikos kataskeuazetai hypo tinos ho de panta kataskeuasas Theos
verses.literal: And every house is built by someone but God is the builder of everything
verses.literalPt: Pois toda casa é estabelecida por alguém, mas o que estabeleceu todas as coisas é Deus.

verses.original: Καὶ Μωϋσῆς μὲν πιστὸς ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ ὡς θεράπων εἰς μαρτύριον τῶν λαληθησομένων
verses.transliteration: Kai Mōusēs men pistos en holō tō oikō autou hōs therapōn eis martyrion tōn lalēthēsomenōn
verses.literal: Now . . . Moses was faithful as a servant in all God’s house testifying to what would be spoken later
verses.literalPt: Moisés, na verdade, era fiel em toda a casa de Deus como um servo, para testemunho das coisas que se haviam de anunciar;

verses.original: Χριστὸς δὲ ὡς υἱὸς ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ οὗ οἶκός ἐσμεν ἡμεῖς ἐὰν τὴν παρρησίαν καὶ τὸ καύχημα τῆς ἐλπίδος κατάσχωμεν
verses.transliteration: Christos de hōs huios epi ton oikon autou hou oikos esmen hēmeis ean tēn parrēsian kai to kauchēma tēs elpidos kataschōmen
verses.literal: But Christ is faithful as the Son over God’s house And we are His house if we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope of which we boast
verses.literalPt: Cristo, porém, como filho, sobre a casa de Deus, a qual casa somos nós, se guardarmos firmes até o fim a nossa confiança e a glória da esperança.

verses.original: Διό καθὼς λέγει τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον Σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε
verses.transliteration: Dio kathōs legei to Pneuma to Hagion Sēmeron ean tēs phōnēs autou akousēte
verses.literal: Therefore as the Holy Spirit says Today if you hear His voice
verses.literalPt: Por isso, diz o Espírito Santo: Hoje, se ouvirdes a sua voz,

verses.original: μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ κατὰ τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ πειρασμοῦ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ
verses.transliteration: mē sklērynēte tas kardias hymōn hōs en tō parapikrasmō kata tēn hēmeran tou peirasmou en tē erēmō
verses.literal: do not harden your hearts as you did in the rebellion in the day of testing in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: não endureçais os vossos corações, como na provocação, no dia da provação no deserto,

verses.original: οὗ ἐπείρασαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἐν δοκιμασίᾳ καὶ εἶδον τὰ ἔργα μου τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη
verses.transliteration: hou epeirasan hoi pateres hymōn en dokimasia kai eidon ta erga mou tesserakonta etē
verses.literal: where your fathers tested and tried Me and for forty years saw My works
verses.literalPt: onde os vossos pais me experimentaram, pondo-me à prova, e viram as minhas obras por quarenta anos.

verses.original: διὸ προσώχθισα τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ καὶ εἶπον Ἀεὶ πλανῶνται τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοὶ δὲ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὰς ὁδούς μου
verses.transliteration: dio prosōchthisa tē genea tautē kai eipon Aei planōntai tē kardia autoi de ouk egnōsan tas hodous mou
verses.literal: Therefore I was angry with that generation and I said Their hearts are always going astray and they have not known My ways
verses.literalPt: Porquanto me indignei contra esta geração e disse: Eles sempre erram no seu coração; não conheceram os meus caminhos.

verses.original: ὡς ὤμοσα ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ μου Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου
verses.transliteration: hōs ōmosa en tē orgē mou Ei eiseleusontai eis tēn katapausin mou
verses.literal: So I swore on oath in My anger They shall never enter . . . My rest
verses.literalPt: Assim, jurei na minha ira: não entrarão no meu descanso.

verses.original: Βλέπετε ἀδελφοί μή‿ ποτε ἔσται ἔν τινι ὑμῶν καρδία πονηρὰ ἀπιστίας ἐν τῷ ἀποστῆναι ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ζῶντος
verses.transliteration: Blepete adelphoi mē pote estai en tini hymōn kardia ponēra apistias en tō apostēnai apo Theou zōntos
verses.literal: See to it brothers that none of you has a wicked heart of unbelief that turns away from the living God
verses.literalPt: Cuidai, irmãos, que não haja, porventura, em algum de vós um perverso coração de incredulidade, em apostatar do Deus vivo;

verses.original: ἀλλὰ παρακαλεῖτε ἑαυτοὺς καθ’ ἑκάστην ἡμέραν ἄχρις οὗ τὸ Σήμερον καλεῖται ἵνα μὴ σκληρυνθῇ τις ἐξ ὑμῶν ἀπάτῃ τῆς ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: alla parakaleite heautous kath’ hekastēn hēmeran achris hou to Sēmeron kaleitai hina mē sklērynthē tis ex hymōn apatē tēs hamartias
verses.literal: But exhort one another . . . daily as long as it is called today so that none of you may be hardened by sin’s deceitfulness
verses.literalPt: mas exortai-vos uns aos outros todos os dias, durante o tempo que se chama Hoje, a fim de que algum de vós não seja endurecido pelo engano do pecado.

verses.original: Μέτοχοι γὰρ τοῦ Χριστοῦ γεγόναμεν ἐάνπερ τὴν ἀρχὴν τῆς ὑποστάσεως μέχρι τέλους βεβαίαν κατάσχωμεν
verses.transliteration: Metochoi gar tou Christou gegonamen eanper tēn archēn tēs hypostaseōs mechri telous bebaian kataschōmen
verses.literal: We have come to share in Christ if we hold firmly to the end the assurance we had at first
verses.literalPt: Pois nos tornamos participantes de Cristo, se guardarmos firmes, até o fim, o princípio da nossa confiança.

verses.original: ἐν τῷ λέγεσθαι Σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε Μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ
verses.transliteration: en tō legesthai Sēmeron ean tēs phōnēs autou akousēte Mē sklērynēte tas kardias hymōn hōs en tō parapikrasmō
verses.literal: As it has been said Today if you hear His voice do not harden your hearts as you did in the rebellion
verses.literalPt: Enquanto se diz: Hoje, se ouvirdes a sua voz, não endureçais os vossos corações, como na provocação.

verses.original: Τίνες γὰρ ἀκούσαντες παρεπίκραναν ἀλλ’ οὐ πάντες οἱ ἐξελθόντες ἐξ Αἰγύπτου διὰ Μωϋσέως
verses.transliteration: Tines gar akousantes parepikranan all’ ou pantes hoi exelthontes ex Aigyptou dia Mōuseōs
verses.literal: For who were the ones who heard and rebelled Were they not all those Moses led out of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Pois quais foram os que, tendo-a ouvido, o provocaram? Não foram todos os que saíram do Egito por meio de Moisés?

verses.original: τίσιν δὲ προσώχθισεν τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη οὐχὶ τοῖς ἁμαρτήσασιν ὧν τὰ κῶλα ἔπεσεν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ
verses.transliteration: tisin de prosōchthisen tesserakonta etē ouchi tois hamartēsasin hōn ta kōla epesen en tē erēmō
verses.literal: And with whom was God angry for forty years Was it not with those who sinned whose bodies fell in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: E contra quem esteve indignado quarenta anos? Não foi contra os que pecaram, cujos corpos caíram no deserto?

verses.original: τίσιν δὲ ὤμοσεν μὴ εἰσελεύσεσθαι εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ εἰ μὴ τοῖς ἀπειθήσασιν
verses.transliteration: tisin de ōmosen mē eiseleusesthai eis tēn katapausin autou ei mē tois apeithēsasin
verses.literal: And to whom did He swear that they would never enter . . . His rest Was it not to those who disobeyed
verses.literalPt: E a quem jurou que não entrariam no seu descanso, senão aos que foram desobedientes?

verses.original: καὶ βλέπομεν ὅτι οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν εἰσελθεῖν δι’ ἀπιστίαν
verses.transliteration: kai blepomen hoti ouk ēdynēthēsan eiselthein di’ apistian
verses.literal: So we see that it was because of their unbelief that they were unable to enter
verses.literalPt: Vemos que não puderam entrar por causa da incredulidade.
